title: calawaya aequiloba
intro: Calawaya aequiloba, commonly known as Kola nut, is a plant species in the family Sterculiaceae. It is widely used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing fever, treating digestive issues, and aiding in weight management. The therapeutic actions of Calawaya aequiloba are attributed to its ability to stimulate digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Calawaya aequiloba include caffeine, theobromine, and xanthines, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
